thread:
maria: quick planning huddle 1: we need a lightweight engagement rubric for the upcoming micro-beta (8 partners, 5wk). want clear pass/fail for launch readiness + a prioritized intake checklist. brainstorming now.

jordan: Agree on small and strict. My draft: 1) integration health (sdk + infra) 2) perf baseline (p50/p95 tokens) 3) eval signal (10 control prompts) 4) security checklist done. Each scored 0/1/2, pass if sum >=6.

tariq: That scoring sounds good. For perf baselines can we use relative thresholds vs their current baseline? e.g., p95 no worse than 1.5x existing system, or absolute p95 < 400ms for hosted.

sana: Need to capture product intent: "proof-of-value" vs "pilot-for-prod". Different bar for pass. If partner marks prod-intent, require A: integration complete, B: SLA smoke test passed, C: legal/compliance signoff.

maria: Good point. Let's add an "intent" field on intake form and route higher-intent partners to a heavier checklist.

jordan: Operational constraint: private runs limited to 2 full-sweep evaluations per week (ops). We should avoid scheduling heavy quantization experiments in parallel.

tariq: On feedback loop: propose 2 channels: 1) weekly 30m sync + 2) short structured async form after each major milestone (integration, eval, handoff). Use a single scorecard with 5 quick questions and a free-text.

sana: Compensation: credits + 2 free SRE hours for first 3 partners who sign up for private. That helps unblock infra work. Solutions team ok?

maria: I'll confirm with solutions. Also propose an "open bug rate" SLO: number of open P1/P2 bugs per partner must be < 2 by week4 or we trigger a remediation plan. That keeps scope narrow.

jordan: Love the SLO idea. Also we should predefine "stop criteria": if more than 40% of partners hit the remediation plan we pause new onboarding.

tariq: Add telemetry requirement: partners must enable request_id and sampling traces. Provide a snippet for client libs: ```python
# example trace header
headers = {"x-request-id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "x-sampling": "1"}
```

sana: Legal: for regulated partners we require DPA + data-flow diagram before kickoff. Also mark these partners as "legal-block" in intake so we don't invite prematurely.

maria: Recruitment funnel: target 50% existing customers with active usage, 30% platform partners, 20% strategic new logos. But let's reserve 1 slot for a regulated partner if legal clears.

jordan: Intake scoring: quick rubric (5 questions, 0-3 each): integration complexity, impact, product fit, infra effort, timeline urgency. Auto-accept if score >=12, manual review 9-11, decline if <9.

tariq: Who owns manual review? product + solutions + eng-reliability. We can do a rotating 2-person panel weekly.

sana: Data collection: we'll auto-collect perf & correctness metrics. For correctness use 10 deterministic prompts + 20 open prompts collected from partner usage. Compute weekly drift and flag >7% drift as an issue.

maria: Action items: 1) maria: publish intake form & scoring rules (due Mon) 2) jordan: build perf baseline script & perf thresholds (due Tue) 3) tariq: ops schedule + telemetry snippet in docs (due Tue) 4) sana: check legal for regulated slot & confirm SRE hours (due Wed) 5) pilot-bot: attach intake link when live.

pilot-bot: Intake form link: https://redwood.internal/dp/micro-beta-intake (will auto-add to repo).

jordan: small hazard note: we should avoid inviting partners with heavy streaming workloads in first wave; runtime streaming optimizations aren't in the first cut. Add "streaming workload" as exclusion unless prod-intent.

tariq: Also recommend a 2-week stagger (waves of 3 partners) to smooth Dedicated usage.

sana: Agree. Also ensure we capture "acceptance owner" at partner side (name + email) on intake. That reduces stalled integrations.

maria: ok i'll synthesize this into a short one-pager and post to /product-recruit. want it tight 1.5 pages max. thanks fam. :rocket:
